properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 9 at 8:26PM EDT until September 9 at 8:45PM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
At 826 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 5 miles northeast of Coudersport, or 35 miles west of
Wellsboro, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

This tornadic storm will remain over mainly rural areas of North
Central Potter County.
properties.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Tornadoes are difficult to observe at night. Take cover now!

Report severe weather to your nearest law enforcement agency or the
National Weather Service office in State College PA.
